conventions.eventNames: Title Case, '<Object> <Past-tense verb>' (e.g. 'Meal Logged'). Names are frozen once shipped: rename in the analytics tool, never in code.
conventions.propertyNames: snake_case. Enum values are lowercase snake_case.
conventions.identity: user_id = FitCircle profile UUID on every platform, set on sign-up/login/session restore, cleared on logout. Never email, name or username.
conventions.privacy: Never send health VALUES (calories, macros, weight, body fat, steps, water volume, workout minutes), free text, emails, names or photos. Send coarse bands or booleans instead (has_weight, duration_band).
conventions.providers: Clients send every event to all enabled providers (Amplitude, PostHog, Sentry breadcrumbs, debug console). A provider is enabled by its key in build config.
conventions.experiments: Experiment arms are generic: control | variantA | variantB | … (the human label lives in Admin Tools). User property exp_<experiment_key> = arm key, set ONLY for randomised (enrolled) users and QA overrides — never for fallback, not-enrolled, layer, layer_conflict or winner assignments. exp_<key>_name = the arm's human label (readable charts). exp_<key>_override = true marks QA overrides; filter them out of readouts. exp_<key>_exposed_at (setOnce) = first exposure. The server sets these on assignment (Amplitude Identify API) and exposure; clients set exp_<key> on exposure and send Experiment Exposed {experiment_key, arm, surface}. Clients route by the arm payload, never by the arm key. exp_onboarding_v2 is the documented example.

events.description: The app asked the OS for its store rating prompt (iOS RequestReview / Play In-App Review) at a positive moment. From 1.1.2 (build 89+) the server decides who is eligible and which moments are on (GET /api/mobile/rating-prompt, Admin Tools → Rating prompt); the app also POSTs /api/mobile/rating-prompt/requested. events.name: Update Prompt Shown
events.description: An app-update prompt was shown (server policy GET /api/mobile/app-update). Soft prompts are frequency-capped per latest_version on device.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: soft = dismissible sheet (below recommended_version); force = blocking screen (below min_supported_version); restart = Android 'Restart to update' card after a flexible download.

properties.name: latest_version
properties.description: Store version the prompt offers (policy latest_version).

properties.name: prompt_count
properties.description: How many times a soft prompt has now been shown for this latest_version (1 = first).

events.name: Update Prompt Accepted
events.description: User tapped Update (or Restart on Android). iOS opens the App Store page in-app (SKStoreProductViewController); Android starts a Play in-app update.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: soft = dismissible sheet (below recommended_version); force = blocking screen (below min_supported_version); restart = Android 'Restart to update' card after a flexible download.

properties.name: latest_version
properties.description: Store version the prompt offers (policy latest_version).

properties.name: method
properties.description: app_store_sheet (iOS in-app store page), play_flexible / play_immediate (Play In-App Updates), store_link (fallback: store listing outside the app).

events.name: Update Prompt Dismissed
events.description: User chose Later on a soft prompt. Closing the in-app App Store page without updating is not this event.

properties.name: latest_version

events.name: Update Downloaded

properties.name: latest_version
